title: Title: Minimal Studio Editorial
prompt:
Title: Minimal Studio Editorial

SCENE:
A clean minimalist fashion studio with a seamless light gray backdrop and matte gray floor. The environment is simple, uncluttered, and designed to keep all attention on the subject and outfit. The overall mood resembles a premium Korean fashion campaign or LOOKBOOK photoshoot.

Portrait orientation in a 9:16 aspect ratio. Full-body composition from the top of the head to the shoes. The subject occupies approximately 80–85% of the frame. Camera positioned slightly below eye level with a natural 50mm perspective, producing realistic body proportions without distortion.

SUBJECT:
A beautiful adult South Korean woman in her early 20s with warm fair porcelain Korean skin, subtle peach undertones, expressive almond-shaped dark brown eyes, refined straight nose, naturally full glossy lips, and soft natural Korean makeup.

She has a naturally slim feminine physique with graceful shoulders, elegant collarbones, naturally full proportional bust with realistic softness and weight, slim toned waist, subtle hourglass silhouette, naturally defined abdomen with soft oblique lines, realistic navel, gently rounded hips, naturally fuller thighs, long slender legs, and realistic anatomy.

MOVEMENT / FACIAL EXPRESSION:
She stands confidently with most of her weight resting on one leg, creating a relaxed natural S-shaped posture.

Both hands rest naturally behind her lower back, gently opening her shoulders and creating a clean editorial silhouette.

Her chin is lifted slightly while she looks directly toward the camera with a calm, confident expression. Lips softly closed, conveying effortless elegance without appearing overly serious.

SKIN / TEXTURE:
Warm fair Korean skin with realistic pores, subtle peach fuzz, healthy natural luminosity, and delicate skin texture.

The abdomen shows gentle natural definition around the waist and oblique lines while maintaining realistic anatomy. Avoid excessive muscle definition or artificial skin smoothing.

OUTFIT / STYLING:
Modern minimalist fashion styling.

She wears a white fitted bandeau tube top made from smooth premium stretch fabric with a clean seamless finish. The bandeau fits naturally across the bust with realistic fabric tension and subtle folds.

She pairs it with light-wash ultra-low-rise wide-leg denim jeans featuring a relaxed oversized silhouette, authentic faded denim texture, subtle distressed details, realistic fabric stacking around the ankles, and a naturally low waistband resting comfortably on the hips.

She wears clean white low-top sneakers.

No jewelry, logos, or distracting accessories.

HAIR:
Short dark chocolate-brown bob gathered into a small high ponytail at the back of the head, creating a playful sporty look while preserving the short length.

Soft wispy bangs naturally frame the forehead, with delicate face-framing strands around the cheeks. The ponytail is short and compact, maintaining a recognizable bob silhouette rather than resembling long hair.

LIGHTING:
Soft professional studio lighting with a large diffused key light positioned slightly above and in front of the subject, balanced by gentle fill lighting to preserve realistic skin texture and subtle shadows.

Soft even illumination across the face, shoulders, abdomen, and jeans while preserving natural depth and realistic tonal transitions. Background evenly lit with a smooth neutral gray gradient.

STYLE / QUALITY:
Ultra-photorealistic Korean fashion editorial photography captured using a professional full-frame camera with a 50mm prime lens.

Premium studio-quality image with realistic skin texture, visible baby hairs, accurate fabric rendering, true-to-life colors, crisp details, highly realistic human anatomy, accurate hands and fingers, subtle editorial color grading, premium Korean LOOKBOOK aesthetic.

Absolutely no CGI, AI-rendered appearance, plastic skin, exaggerated anatomy, or excessive beauty filtering.
